body.name: \((F_{k,t,D},F'_{k,t,D})\)
body.construction: Choose encoded vertex and edge subsets \(F_{k,t,D}\subseteq F'_{k,t,D}\subseteq H_{k,t}\) that each have one bidirected district, give every observed vertex at most one directed child, and have the same childless set \(R_0\), with \(F_{k,t,D}\cap X=\varnothing\), \(F'_{k,t,D}\cap X\ne\varnothing\), and \(R_0\subseteq\operatorname{An}_{H_{k,t}\setminus X}(Y)\).
